#!/bin/bash
# VERSION, package.json and the newest CHANGELOG heading must agree.
v=$(cat VERSION)
p=$(jq -r .version package.json)
c=$(grep -m1 '^## ' CHANGELOG.md | sed 's/^## //')
if [ "$v" = "$p" ] && [ "$v" = "$c" ]; then
  mkdir -p build; echo "version $v consistent" | tee build/version-check.txt
else
  echo "mismatch: VERSION=$v package.json=$p CHANGELOG=$c"; exit 1
fi
